scorpion-sting.9: Bawaskar 2011: all 9 patients who worsened had vomited their first oral dose, delaying it by 60 min; injectable prazosin is not available in India.
scorpion-sting.13: JIPMER 2015 and 2018 (children ≤12–13 years): oral prazosin 30 µg/kg per dose every 3 h until the extremities are warm.
scorpion-sting.23: Bawaskar 2011 RCT (grade 2, within 6 h): SAV plus prazosin resolved 91% within 10 h vs 23% on prazosin alone; mean recovery 8 vs 17.7 h.
scorpion-sting.91: Bawaskar 2011 RCT (grade 2, within 6 h): SAV plus prazosin resolved 91% within 10 h vs 23% on prazosin alone; mean recovery 8 vs 17.7 h.
scorpion-sting.173: Systematic review 2017: SAV plus prazosin gives faster resolution than prazosin alone (3 Indian trials, 173 patients) in adults and children over 6 months.
scorpion-sting.600: Systematic review 2017 (Tunisian RCT, 600 patients): steroids gave no benefit. Kumar 2022: higher mortality seen in children given steroids and antihistamines.

poisoning-general.15: check urine pH every 15–30 min, target 7.5–8.5.

corrosives.0: Zargar 1991 (PGIMER): grades 0, 1 and 2a recovered without sequelae; 71.4% of 2b and all grade 3 survivors developed scarring.
corrosives.1: WSES 2019: transmural necrosis — operate as soon as possible (Grade 1C) and resect all obvious necrosis at the first operation (Grade 2A).

carbon-monoxide.1: ECHM 2016: give 100% oxygen immediately to anyone with CO poisoning as first aid (Type 1, Level C).
carbon-monoxide.3: ECHM 2016: minor CO poisoning — 12 h of normobaric oxygen or HBOT is reasonable (Type 3, Level B).
carbon-monoxide.5.4: FDA Nithiodote label §5.4: use with caution in smoke inhalation or CO poisoning — methaemoglobin may worsen hypoxia.
